title: Complexity Edges Drill
description: Complexity Edges Drill — migrated from complexity_edges_drill.py.

lines.text: Complexity and edges drill. Short loop. Speak with the candidate.
State time and space for token bucket allow.
Time O of one expected. Space O of number of clients.
Edges for array problems almost always?
Empty, single element, all equal, already sorted, reverse sorted, duplicates, negatives, min and max values.
Capacity zero or one, get miss, update existing, eviction order, repeated access freshness.
Zero, negative reject, overflow awareness, integer minor units, rounding policy.
When is O of n squared unacceptable?
When n is one e five style large. Say the constraint that kills nested loops.
End drill. State edges before interviewer asks.
